headline: TOR @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 4.92 at DET 3.85, with a projected total of 8.77. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TOR: TOR moved +0.80 runs while DET moved -0.58, changing the projected margin by +1.39 runs. NRFI probability rose +17.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Jack Flaherty has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Riley Greene, Daulton Varsho, Kazuma Okamoto, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Vladimir Guerrero Jr., Brandon Valenzuela because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
